title: The canal
subtitle: Jump it, wade it, or take the plank.

sections.name: Bund
sections.note: The bund road between the paddies: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstCanal
sections.note: The first canal, 1.2 m: a held jump clears it; the rooster flutters across first.

sections.name: Plank
sections.note: A 1.8 m canal, too wide for a sure jump: the plank bridge is the way across.

sections.name: Ducks
sections.note: Two ducks waddling up from the canal across the bund: jump them.

sections.name: Haystack
sections.note: A small haystack at the roadside: hop onto it (mangoes along its top) or over it.

sections.name: WideCanal
sections.note: The widest canal, 2.6 m: double jump (the mangoes show where), or wade.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: Room to breathe: a wave of mangoes and the first chilli.

sections.name: Sacks
sections.note: Sacks of paddy waiting for the cart: hop onto them; a feather above for a double jump. Then dung.

sections.name: CanalDung
sections.note: A canal, then dung: jump, land, tap.

sections.name: Haystacks
sections.note: Three small haystacks: hop, hop, hop; a feather above the last.

sections.name: PlankThenJump
sections.note: The plank, then a canal with no plank: walk, then jump.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A long straight and a chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: SacksCanal
sections.note: Onto the sacks and off their end straight over a canal.

sections.name: WideAgain
sections.note: The wide canal again: double jump.

sections.name: DucksHaystack
sections.note: Ducks crossing, then a small haystack.

sections.name: CanalTrio
sections.note: Three 1.2 m canals in a rhythm: jump, jump, jump.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: Dung; then the rooster knocks the water pots off their stand by the well into the road; a canal after.

sections.name: PlankHaystack
sections.note: The plank, then a haystack.

sections.name: ChilliRun
sections.note: A chilli and a run of mangoes.

sections.name: CanalSacksCanal
sections.note: Canal, sacks, canal.

sections.name: WideHaystack
sections.note: The wide canal, then a haystack straight after it.

sections.name: DungDucks
sections.note: Dung, then ducks: tap, jump.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: ThreeWidths
sections.note: All three canals in a row: jump the 1.2 m, walk the plank over the 1.8 m, double jump the 2.6 m.

sections.name: HaystackDung
sections.note: Two haystacks and dung between them.

sections.name: Sugarcane
sections.note: Past the sugarcane: a 1.8 m canal with no plank (a full jump, or a double), then ducks.

sections.name: LastWide
sections.note: The last wide canal, and a haystack after it.

sections.name: OpenBund
sections.note: The bund opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 295 m.
